newsitem.title: UK: Mill demand for raw cotton at low ebb in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Mill demand for raw cotton at low ebb in Europe.

text.p: Mill demand for raw cotton was at a low ebb in almost all European markets, reflecting reluctance among spinners to anticipate additional summer-autumn shipment needs in the prevailing business climate.
Small transactions were nonetheless negotiated, mainly in African Franc Zone and Central Asian medium/better qualities, with attention coming from Italy, Portugal and Germany.
Eastern European markets generally lacked feature, and no interest was evident for long staple varieties.
